title: Practical Bar Stools, Pleasing to Look at
text:
Practical Bar Stools, Pleasing to Look at. My household contains a few different bars. We have a bar in our front living area, a breakfast bar, and a bar on our patio. When you have bars, it’s always good to have bar stools to accommodate and this need led me to get the Ashley Furniture Bellatier Adjustable height Bar Stool package.

These stools are upholstered with a black- colored cushion that helps add to the comfort. They have a foot rest and a handle on the sides to adjust the height. The black and stainless steel colors means that the stools will match most décor and I find they look really nice next to our breakfast bar in the kitchen, since most of our appliances, large and small, are either stainless steel or black in color.

Assembling these bar stools is extremely easy and intuitive- you could easily figure out what to do without even reading the instructions. They are very light weight also, making them easy to transport from one place to the next. And they swivel 360 degrees so you can turn to face different directions if you like.

If I had to find some negative things to say about this product, one would be the lack of arms. Bar stools are more comfortable and look nicer if they include arms. The seat and back are small in size, so they don’t offer much room to handle different size people. Also, unless I’m completely misunderstanding something, I cannot get the adjustment arm to work. I have moved it up and down, again and again, and I cannot get the height to adjust. Lucky for me, the height at which they are presently set is just right for what I need, but if I ever decide to move the chairs someplace else, I may run into a problem since the adjustment function appears not to work.

Bar chairs are essential when your home has as many bars as mine. Ashley Furniture Bellatier Adjustable height Bar Stools are pleasing to look at and they match most décor. The issue with the adjustment lever is a concern, but other than that and other minor issues, these are good bar stools and I like that they come two in a pack.
